test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Amrit felt a chill run down his spine as Mrityu __gazed__ at him mid-conversation.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **glanced**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"gazed"** means to look steadily and intently, especially in admiration, surprise, or thought. (टकटकी लगाकर देखना)

 
 
• **Example: **She gazed at the beautiful sunset, lost in its colors.
 
 
 
• **"Glanced"** refers to taking a brief or hurried look. It is the opposite of gazing, which involves a prolonged and steady look. (झलक देखना)
 
 
• **Example: **He glanced at his watch and realized he was late for the meeting.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'gazed' **is **'glanced'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **glanced**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Shouted** (चिल्लाया): To utter a loud call or cry, typically as an expression of a strong emotion.

 
 
• **Example: **He shouted for help when he saw the fire.
 
 
 
• **Shot** (गोली मारी): The act of firing a gun or another projectile weapon.
 
 
• **Example: **The hunter shot the deer from a distance.
 
 
 
• **Stared** (घूरना): To look fixedly or vacantly at someone or something with one's eyes wide open.
 
 
• **Example: **He stared at the painting, trying to understand its meaning.
